# HexPiece 3.4.0

**Dawn Pistol's final blow**, after your notes on 3.3.9 ("it looks cool but ... its not that... the fist goes through the body, stretching
the skin to insane amounts and then causes a catastrophic knockback that destroys all blocks in it's way") and your Egghead frames of
Luffy's last punch on Lucci. Not tested in game yet: the build and all tests pass, and the move was rendered and judged
(docs/gifs/nika-dawn-pistol-3.4.0.gif is a preview, not the game: there the stretched skin is painted the shirt's red; in game it is the
struck body's own skin).

- **The fist goes through the body.** Whoever Dawn Pistol hits is held where they stand for a quarter of a second while their own skin
  (their own texture: a player's skin, a zombie's shirt, any mob's own look) is dragged out of their far side along the punch into a long
  funnel, about 7 blocks, body-wide where it leaves them and narrowing to the fist, glowing red, then orange, then white-hot round the fist
  at its end.
- **Then the catastrophic knockback.** The skin snaps back into the body and the body is blasted away along the punch, tearing through
  every block in its way up to obsidian (never bedrock, chests or anything protected), the ground shaking, a crash where it stops, and it
  lands knocked down. The torn blocks grow back by themselves after 15 to 25 seconds, as with the Light fruit's kick.
- The rubber "taffy" bend from 3.3.9 is gone (Star Gun's own bend is unchanged). The wind-up, the black ballooned fist, the POW (now
  smaller, so it no longer hides the body) and the punch sound stay.
